summary: Configured and verified daily rotation of /var/log/inventory/app.log with seven compressed archives and uninterrupted writes via copytruncate. The configuration and log data persisted across node1's mandatory reboot.
actions_performed: Created /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app with daily, rotate 7, compress, missingok, notifempty, and copytruncate
Forced a rotation while holding the log open and confirmed writing continued on the same inode
Confirmed the enabled systemd logrotate timer runs daily
Safely rebooted node1 and verified configuration, scheduler, archives, retained data, and writability after recovery

evidence.requirement: Rotate /var/log/inventory/app.log daily and retain seven compressed rotations
evidence.summary: Shows the installed policy, successful parser validation, enabled daily timer, seven-rotation retention, compression, and valid post-reboot archives.

evidence.requirement: Allow the application to continue writing after rotation
evidence.summary: A writer kept the log open across forced rotation; the inode was unchanged, its subsequent write succeeded, and post-reboot writing also succeeded.
Captures healthy pre-reboot state and boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered timer, policy, log data, archive integrity, and writability.
